hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command','').strip())" 2>/dev/null || true); m=0; case "$CMD" in rg|rg\ *|fd|fd\ *|ack\ *|ag\ *) m=1 ;; find\ .*|find\ /*|find\ ~*) m=1 ;; grep\ -*r*|grep\ -*R*|grep\ --recursive*|grep\ --include*) m=1 ;; esac; if [ "$m" = "1" ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. Skim GRAPH_REPORT.md before searching raw files."}}'; fi
